title: Massive holomorphicity of near-critical dimers and sine-Gordon model
summary: In this paper, we consider the near-critical dimer model in the setup of isoradial superpositions with Temperleyan boundary conditions. We show that the centered height function converges as the mesh size tends to zero to a limiting field which agrees with the (electromagnetically tilted) sine-Gordon model, whose derivative correlations are described by Grassmann variables (or equivalently determinants involving a massive Dirac operator).
